claims.statement: The European Commission announced that mandatory use of EUDAMED's actor registration, UDI/device registration, notified bodies and certificates, and market-surveillance modules began on 28 May 2026.
The Commission explains that the mandatory date was triggered by publication of a functionality notice and followed a six-month transition period.

The Commission roadmap shows later mandatory rollout for the vigilance and clinical-investigation or performance-study modules, creating possible repeat adaptation work but not a guaranteed subscription need.

contrary_evidence: EUDAMED provides its own interface, information centre, and training, so an external tool must prove error reduction or bulk efficiency.
The initial mandatory migration wave is already under way and may be a temporary services spike.
Large regulatory-information-management vendors already serve manufacturers with complex catalogues.

economics.acquisition_route: Referral fees to medical-device regulatory and identifier advisers plus fixed-price sample audits of a catalogue extract
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Scenario, not evidence: 500 manufacturers averaging PLN 35,000 annual revenue across subscription and repeat projects yields PLN 17.5m revenue; a 40% operating margin could support PLN 20m-plus cumulative founder wealth over six to eight mature years
economics.founder_time: Three to four hours per day with catalogue-size caps and consultant-owned regulatory meetings
economics.gross_margin_basis: Reusable imports and validation rules can exceed 80% gross margin; nomenclature exceptions and source-data cleanup reduce initial project margin
economics.payback: Target immediate payback because migrations are milestone-billed and the first sample is the only unpaid work
economics.pricing: Assumption: PLN 8,000-40,000 per catalogue migration plus PLN 800-3,000 per month for validation, change history, and future-module readiness
economics.retention_or_repeat: New devices, identifier changes, certificate updates, and later module rollouts create repeat work, but static catalogues may churn after migration

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A validated error corpus across device families, identifier relationships, nomenclature, and record-change patterns that improves pre-submission checks
fingerprint.customer: Polish and EU medical-device SMEs with roughly 50 to 5,000 catalogue records, initially dental, rehabilitation, diagnostic-consumable, and low-risk device manufacturers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Medical-device regulatory consultants, UDI identifier advisers, and specialist training firms refer catalogue work while retaining formal regulatory responsibility
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: A secure catalogue that imports spreadsheets, normalises identifiers and nomenclature, validates relationships and required fields, flags duplicates and conflicts, and produces upload-ready or guided-entry packages; migration project plus subscription
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The regulatory-affairs or quality lead pays per catalogue migration after a sampled acceptance test, then pays monthly for change validation and record history
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Mandatory use of EUDAMED's actor, UDI/device, notified-body and certificate, and market-surveillance modules began on 28 May 2026, forcing manufacturers to move product master data into a structured EU system

founder_fit: Entity resolution, taxonomy mapping, and data-quality validation match the founder's core skills
The medical-student partner can improve workflow vocabulary without substituting for regulatory expertise
A fixed-size catalogue migration is testable before any broad SaaS build
Consultant referral channels reduce cold networking and keep formal advice outside the product
risks: A wrong identifier relationship or classification could block or corrupt a regulated device record.
The service may be perceived as regulatory advice despite contractual boundaries.
Sensitive technical and certificate data require strong tenant isolation and auditability.
Manual exception work may prevent scalable margins.

structure.commercial_archetype: Managed regulated-master-data service with catalogue SaaS
structure.control_point: The canonical device record and deterministic validation step immediately before authorised EUDAMED submission or update
structure.critical_dependency: Accurate UDI and device-rule implementation, stable portal or bulk-upload mechanisms, and final review by the manufacturer's authorised regulatory owner

thesis: A managed master-data and validation service can help small medical-device manufacturers clean actor, UDI, device, certificate, and nomenclature records before authorised staff submit or update them in EUDAMED. The product is not regulatory sign-off; it is a canonical catalogue, deterministic validation, and change log that reduces repeated data-entry errors after four modules became mandatory on 28 May 2026.
title: EUDAMED UDI Catalogue Operations for Small Device Makers
uncertainties: Current bulk-upload, machine-to-machine, and export capabilities need hands-on verification before product scoping.
The number and catalogue size of underserved Polish or regional manufacturers are unknown.
Ongoing change frequency may not support the assumed monthly subscription.
Pricing and the 500-manufacturer wealth scenario lack buyer validation.
